entries.title: Ask in chat from Glossary or Citations
entries.body: On an article you added, open a Glossary entry or a row in Citations and press Ask in chat: a new Chat conversation opens with a question already written, and nothing is sent until you press Send. Afterwards the entry carries a mark that reopens that conversation beside it. Chat's conversation list can also be filtered to those started from Glossary or Citations.

entries.title: Sharing options sit together when adding an article
entries.body: The add page has one Sharing section, closed until you open it, holding Make it public and a new Create a private link. The progress card for the article you are adding appears sooner. Someone who opens a shared link before the article has finished being added sees a page saying so, which opens the article once it is ready.

entries.title: Long articles keep their summaries more often
entries.body: Sometimes the app could not build the levels of detail for a long article, or one with very long sections, and fell back to an outline made from headings alone, without the short summaries. It now splits oversized requests into smaller ones, asks once more after some failures, and can pick up where it left off when time runs out.

entries.title: Quote highlights are less vivid in dark appearance
entries.body: In the dark appearance, the purple used to highlight quotes was too saturated and has been toned down. The light appearance is unchanged.

entries.title: Old links into Learn open at Recall
entries.body: Learn's addresses now use the word Learn. Older bookmarks still open Learn, but one that pointed at a particular part of it, such as the quiz, opens at Recall instead. If you had an article open in a tab while this changed, reload it before your next Recall answer, which may otherwise fail to send.

entries.title: One kind of bot-check page is refused
entries.body: Some sites answer with a page checking you are not a bot instead of the article. One kind of these was being added to your library as an article titled 'Making sure you're not a bot!'. The app now recognises it and stops, with a message asking you to save the page from your own browser and upload the file.

entries.title: Failed Retry or Edit no longer hides messages
entries.body: If Retry or Edit in a saved conversation failed, or the connection dropped, before the answer began, the conversation on screen stayed missing messages that were still saved, until you reloaded. It now goes back to how it was and checks the saved copy. This covers Chat and Learn's conversations.

entries.title: Article title stays over the text beside notes
entries.body: With the Marginalia column (the notes to the right of the article) on and no panel open, the title at the top drifted to the right of the text on narrower windows, such as a tablet or small laptop, and at some widths ran under the notes. It now stays above the text at every window width.
